records.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Produce one game sprite atlas PNG on a genuinely transparent alpha background, wide 1536x1024, a strict 3 columns x 2 rows grid of equal 512x512 cells. Input 1 is identity reference: keep ONLY its small brown cute illustrated owl from the first row, same warm painterly style, cream face, amber eyes and feather markings. Input 2 is scale/style reference for the garden habitat, do NOT include the scene. Six owl states in reading order: idle perched looking forward, a brief eyes-closed blink, head turned gently right, relaxed settled lower body, preparing takeoff with body crouched and wings half raised, takeoff wings open upward. Same size body and same feet anchor at x50% y78% of each cell for first five states. Last takeoff feet near same anchor, wings open but fully contained. Every feather, tail and wing must have generous padding at least 55 pixels from every cell border. Owl occupies at most 65% of cell width including wings. No trees, no branch, no ground, no shadow oval, no text, no grid lines, no scenery, no other species. Six separate sprites only. Maintain consistent identity. Actual transparent alpha, not checkerboard art.
records.mattePrompt: Use case: background-extraction. Create an EXACT PIXEL REGISTERED alpha matte for the attached 1536x1024 sprite atlas. Keep the image dimensions and ALL six object outlines at exactly the original positions and scale. Render only opaque silhouettes of the six owls INCLUDING every feather, wing, foot and beak in pure solid WHITE (#ffffff), and ALL surrounding background and gaps inside the objects in pure BLACK (#000000). Remove the checkerboard entirely; every background square must be black. The interiors of objects must be solid white with no shading, textures or gray markings. Only a tiny 1px antialias edge. Do not draw a new object. This is a technical MASK matching the input exactly. No grids, no captions, no checkerboard, no color. Same width 1536 and height 1024.

records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one foliage texture atlas on a genuinely transparent alpha background, wide 1536x1024, strict 3 columns x 2 rows, equal 512x512 cells. Both input images are style and light references for an existing small warm painterly garden. Render SIX DIFFERENT isolated grounded botanical clusters that blend exactly into this illustrated landscape: top-left low broad round sage leaves with sparse cream daisy, top-middle irregular narrow meadow grass in soft olive green, top-right airy small wildflower stems with muted tiny white blossoms, bottom-left delicate pond rushes with tapered reeds, bottom-middle low asymmetric leafy shrub with a few ochre leaf tips, bottom-right small lavender-like herb and grass. Not six variants of same form. Soft warm light from upper right, muted moss/sage/olive colors with painterly texture and natural shaded bases. 3/4 front view matching garden ground plants; no pots, no tiles, no soil chunk, no hard ground line. Rooted stems at x50% y85% of each cell, feathered alpha at the root, every plant entirely contained with minimum 45px transparent padding on left/right/top and 50px below. All clusters at believable scale next to the stone path and stall; no huge tropical leaves. No scenery, text, grid lines, white background or baked checkerboard. True transparent alpha, one atlas only.
